Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer used an overly broad and generic search query (`American Alligator first found west of Texas site:usgs.gov`), leading to irrelevant results on the USGS Nonindigenous Aquatic Species page. Despite the user request specifying the first year the American Alligator was found west of Texas (excluding Texas), WebSurfer failed to focus on gathering specific chronological data in the results. Instead of refining the search query or navigating to targeted sections of the page, it relied on extracting metadata and visible OCR text, which did not include the year 1954. This initial lack of specificity resulted in an incomplete response and a failure to locate the required information. Subsequent navigations were not corrective or efficient and thus contributed to the erroneous final answer (1976).
